description: Moves the reconciler and the status page to the latest version the monorepo published (D109). Only platform.yml is watched: from the 1st to the 10th of the month, one grouped pull request, merged by Renovate when Validate is green, on a weekday between 9:00 and 17:00 (Paris). Only v1.0.<n> steps merge by themselves; a minor or major step waits for the owner. App images are never touched (D5).

customManagers.description: reconciler.image and status.image, pinned as "<image>:v<x.y.z>@sha256:<digest>" (bivy pin).

packageRules.description: Only patch steps (v1.0.<n>) and new digests merge by themselves.
